description: This file contains benchmarking utilities for PyTorch operators, including functions for measuring speedups, converting graphs, and running performance tests with various configurations. It is part of a microbenchmark suite for operator performance analysis within the PyTorch project.

methods.name: maybe_record_function
methods.description: Returns a profiler record function context if profiling is enabled, otherwise a null context.

methods.name: compute_speedups
methods.description: Measures median speedups of models over multiple repeats, optionally checking accuracy.

methods.name: strip_overloads
methods.description: Modifies a FX graph module to strip overloads from operator nodes.

methods.name: convert_to_jit
methods.description: Converts a FX graph module to a scripted or traced JIT module.

methods.name: to_channels_last
methods.description: Converts a tensor to channels-last memory format if it is 4D.

methods.name: microbenchmark
methods.description: Runs a microbenchmark on a given operator with specified inputs and configurations, returning median speedups.

methods.name: quantiles
methods.description: Calculates specified quantiles of timing measurements.

methods.name: skip_operator
methods.description: Determines whether to skip benchmarking certain operators based on heuristics and known limitations.
